cn.t: Critics praise this wickedly funny, subversive comedy about a demonic sock puppet as shockingly irreverent yet surprisingly moving, with Steven Boyer's manic performance earning raves. A few find it overstretched, but most celebrate its audacious blend of profanity and depth.
